descriptions.g5c_stream_seek_80208e34: Seeks an external bounded stream using unsigned32-bit offsets. Optionally reports the previous position before validation; origin0 uses the supplied offset, origin1 adds the current position, and origin2 adds the extent. Returns0x90000002 for an unsupported origin or0x90000003 when the resulting unsigned position exceeds the extent; otherwise stores the new position and returns zero. Position and extent are observed external words at offsets28 and32; no data or complete local object is owned. Names are inferred.
